results.title: Grounded in Love
results.overview: Annie is a career flight attendant who loves her job and traveling the world, is dealt a blow when an airlines merger causes her to be furloughed, a setback further compounded by breaking up with a selfish boyfriend. Looking for a reprieve, Annie drives from Manhattan to her grandmother’s Kentucky farm. After a few character-building days, life on the farm ultimately brings Annie unexpected blessings in the form of rediscovering her faith, and reconnecting with her handsome childhood friend, Jake, who has just moved back from the big city to create a more grounded and intentional life for himself.

results.title: Wait List: A Love-ish Story
results.overview: The woman of Carter Morgan's dreams is his childhood friend's mother, Lisa Chase. When Carter finds out she's gotten divorced, he decides to go for it despite the obstacles that are placed in their way.

results.title: Incoherence
results.overview: Over three episodes, three respectable middle-aged men find themselves behaving badly. A teacher hides his pornographic magazine from a female student. A jogger steals milk and blames it on a newspaper delivery boy. A drunk man desperately searches for a public toilet late at night.

results.title: The Climb of the Shoeshiner
results.original_title: O Engraxate Que Escalou o Everest
results.overview: A former shoe shiner overcomes poverty to conquer the world's highest peak.

results.title: Wishbone
results.overview: When the twenty eight -year-old Kostas who has recently become a security guard in a public hospital, is forced to take over the guardianship of his little niece, he gets involved in a medical scam to make ends meet.

results.title: Don't Tell Anyone
results.original_title: ပြန်မပြောရ
results.overview: A story about 4 friends encountering unexpected events that would change their lives forever... Accidentally or is it bound to fate?

results.title: Not My Family: The Monique Smith Story
results.original_title: Not My Family: The Monique Smith Story
results.overview: Monique Smith endures years of horrific abuse at the hands of her family, only to learn that she isn't related to them at all. Searching for truth, Monique embarks on a life-long quest to discover her true identity and biological origins.

results.title: Unexpected Treasures
results.overview: In the heart of Joshua Tree, a wild alien adventure restores a local resident's faith in humanity.

results.title: I Am Raquel Welch
results.overview: I AM RAQUEL WELCH is a feature documentary that celebrates the life of a trailblazing actress and single mother who not only redefined the world's idea of a Hollywood "Sex Symbol," but also led the way for modern-day action heroines.

results.title: Morning Vigil
results.overview: A pious sister and her inflexible brother mourn the passing of their beloved mother.

results.title: boysick
results.overview: Milàn has a broken heart since his breakup with Gaëtan. In denial, Milàn makes one last attempt by following him on a dating app.

results.title: Detox Inn
results.overview: Sandra, a young influencer, retreats to a remote hotel in the Alps for a “digital detox”. When she arrives there, she quickly realizes that this detox involves more than she bargained for.

results.title: Portal in the Pines
results.overview: A rural fireman discovers that a secret particle collider has opened a portal to hell.

results.title: Varnished
results.overview: In the quiet English suburbs of Oak Valley, something is afoot…  When a local couple’s irreplaceable dining table mysteriously vanishes, the village becomes the centre of a gripping criminal investigation. Detective Inspector Armoire is on the case (and grateful for something to do), but can he find the culprit?  In a series of local interviews and dramatic reconstructions, Laura Eccles, Oak Valley’s local community librarian, reveals the truth behind the missing furniture in this exclusive exposé.

results.title: The Summer That Snowed
results.overview: Amir and Mahi, a wealthy couple trapped in a crumbling marriage filled with doubt and secrecy. Battling a severe midlife crisis and an intense phobia of loss, Amir retreats into a heavy silence. The family's fragile dynamic reaches a breaking point when their teenage daughter, Sadaf, decides to leave for a music festival in Paris, forcing Amir to choose between holding his family together or fulfilling her dream.

results.title: Elephant
results.overview: When a guileless young man meets his girlfriend’s stoic father to ask for her hand in marriage, his attempt to honour cultural traditions goes awry.

results.title: Blossom
results.overview: A young woman moving out on her own for the first time, decides to spend the drive to her new city, doing all these things she’s always been too afraid to do.
